cause_quote: The introducing diff added `new PollController(` with a `2_000` ms interval whose callback called `void this.statusTask.run();` whenever the Gateway was connected and no status request was pending, regardless of tab visibility.
user_saw: The Storage settings tab kept sending maintenance status requests to the Gateway every two seconds while hidden.
summary: The fix pauses automatic maintenance status polling while the tab is hidden and refreshes the status when the tab becomes visible again.
reasoning: The original Storage settings feature used a PollController whose timer called its callback regardless of tab visibility. I checked that the later visibility-aware controller defaulted to always polling and that Storage settings still used that default immediately before the Solid migration carried the same behavior forward with a raw interval.
